data.description:
Addendum to existing finding #85: the May discovery volume is already recorded. The additional evidence here is independently verified alternate-production and test-host file retrieval, plus the contrast with the 34 failed URLQuery numbered-download records. The separate March API/workbook comparison in #85 is not being relabeled as a bypass.

The May 6-22, 2026 Maryland education history combines systematic filename/API discovery with actual aggregate-file retrieval. Expanded Arquivo acquisition contains 264,526 fixed-depth candidate-file captures covering 203,851 distinct basenames, varying word order, capitalization, separators and extensions. This supports generated-looking filename discovery rather than evidence of unbounded recursive crawling. Captures, basenames and actors are different counts, and most guesses are redirects/errors rather than recovered files.

Verified successes include an alternate production host, msp2018.msde.maryland.gov, returning an Attendance_2017 CSV ZIP at May 17 11:05:57 UTC (1,649 data rows), and a 2018 state participation-rate CSV ZIP at 11:11:38 (48,949 rows). The corresponding main-host paths returned Cloudflare origin errors 525 and 520 in the same period. A test-named host, reportcardtest.msde.maryland.gov, returned a verified 2022 MCAP English-language-arts/mathematics ZIP at May 6 10:54:59, with school, district and state aggregate sheets. Its earlier time must not be rearranged into success following that afternoon's filename burst. A sampled development-host request instead remained 401.

Separately, all 34 reviewed URLQuery numbered-download reports on May 15-22 returned HTTP 500 and 47,644 bytes of HTML. A May 22 burst covers 23 reports across most IDs 380-404 in roughly 42 seconds. Equal lengths do not mean byte-identical responses. Those failures must not be generalized to the entire archive history, which contains the verified successful downloads above.

This establishes persistent discovery and availability through alternate/test-named hosts. It does not establish authentication bypass, IDOR, individual student records or evasion of suppression. A test/development-looking hostname does not itself prove the content was restricted. The None cyberattack tag reflects the absence of an established security-boundary violation; enumeration alone is not denial of service. Common authorship, AI involvement and authorization are unknown.

Untapped source is Yes: the acquisition holds 334,668 distinct Maryland archive locations across queried May-June partitions, while only selected file/API bodies were recovered and examined. Many known indexed candidates remain for outcome/content review. The small June subset includes unrelated Maryland energy assets and must not extend the education sequence into June.
data.summary: Maryland education records show systematic filename/endpoint discovery and verified public aggregate downloads from alternate/test hosts. A separate 34-report URLQuery series failed; no authentication bypass is established.
